ja: 30MSシリーズより、汎用水転写式デカール第２弾が登場！
• 別売りの“30 MINUTES SISTERS”のフェイスパーツをデコーレーションできる様々なデカールで自分好みにシスターの表情をキャラメイキング可能。

en: The second general-purpose water transfer decal from the 30MS series is now available!
• You can create the sister's expression to your liking with various decals that can decorate the face parts of "30 MINUTES SISTERS" (sold separately).
• Use the unpainted face parts included in the "30MS Option Parts" series (sold separately) to enrich your character's expressions!
